bayts.text: From the Real (Al-Ḥaqq) came the Truth (the Qurʾān) to the Truthful (the Prophet), among the Companions, with a manifest truth that suffers no difficulty:
a Book through which we hope for mercy from Allah, and through which we are saved, in this world and the Next, from distress.
We have hoped from the Master, through it, the best of requests, and through it we have triumphed in every warding-off and every drawing-in.
It has become for us a lasting treasure, a glory: through it the Master guards us from the harm of every creeping thing.
When we recite its verses, we attain what is hidden from others than us of its secret that draws love.
Through it we have overcome all enemies, and it has led us to the Most Generous, the Bestower, in distance and in nearness.
There parted from us, through it, enemies, doubt and trial, and plenty was granted us after drought had vanished.
We obtained it, by reception, from Him Who guided us, by the standing of him whose praises have become my custom.
Upon him the blessing of Allah — exalted is His Majesty —, with his Companions, besides his Family, the most excellent of parties.
Upon him the peace of Allah, as long as there is a chosen one, and as long as the Master, through him, has softened the hardest of hardships.
